reason: The window's AC requires concrete counts while a review runs; the walker and the review service own the only place those counts exist, so a read-only progress callback must be added there.
boundary_review: Adds a progress callback (entries, folders, objects, elapsed, current top-level folder) that the walker reports at most every 256 folders, and passes it through ReviewService. Walk behaviour, budgets, outputs and storage are unchanged; the TASK-621 suites and its mutation tests still cover them. Acceptance, non-goals (no delete action, no notch surface), dependencies and authority are unchanged.
